title: GoOrganicAfrica Republic of the Congo calculator readiness review

findings: INS-Congo catalogue lists RGA-Congo 2024 preliminary results.
INS-Congo catalogue lists the 2023 cultivated-area and production report.
Catalogue also lists the 2022 agricultural holdings report, 2021 food-crop census and 2020 agricultural atlas.
official_statistics_catalogue.interpretation: Source inventory verified; numerical tables not yet extracted or independently reconciled.

findings: Cassava is identified as the main food crop and is cultivated throughout the year in northern and southern regions according to rainy seasons.
FAO describes 2026 maize conditions as generally favourable and the main-season output as near average, but does not provide a numeric yield.
FAO forecasts 410,000 tonnes of cereal imports for 2026, including 260,000 tonnes of wheat and 100,000 tonnes of rice; cereal imports are estimated at about 90 percent of cereal utilization.
seasonal_context.caveat: Import forecasts and qualitative crop outlooks are not farmgate prices, crop yields or domestic production values.

findings: A newer secondary source reports 15 departments following laws published in October 2024.
geography.decision: Do not add a regional selector or map historical crop observations until official department names, codes, legal effective date and boundary crosswalk are verified.

blockers: INS 2024 preliminary and 2023 crop tables require numeric extraction and reconciliation.
Administrative geography is inconsistent across available sources.
No validated current crop-specific farmgate price series.
No validated farmer-facing input quotations or regional enterprise budgets.
Calculator mapping and test cases remain pending.

safeguards: Research evidence only; not calculator input.
No existing active country profile or calculator formula changed.
No unverified administrative units added to the region registry.
